answer: Tie identity-minting to a simultaneous liveness storm: at a random tick the protocol fires timed, context-dependent sub-tasks at every agent at once. One honestly anchored in its own harbor of warm memory answers inside the window; a sybil farm sharing one backend thrashes and misses. Refract each reply through a prism that splits its latency and reasoning-style into a spectral fingerprint, ferrous-hard to forge, and any cluster collapsing to a single spectrum forfeits its bond. Attacker pays for N truly independent warm pipelines, not one mask-wearing host.
